_meta.description: Happy-path response for GET /api/vehicles — the SDK's vehicle-enumeration entry point (rest-api.md §7.0). Owner-tier projection: every VehicleSummary field is present. The list is deliberately a thin catalog — no GPS, no nav, no climate (those live in /snapshot). v1 returns owned vehicles only; viewer-merged enumeration is PLANNED. MYR-233 adds the optional P0 `hasActiveRide` flag: Stumpy is parked at a pickup with an open INSTANT ride (accepted/arrived/enroute) so it renders Busy; Lightning is free. The flag is derived read-time from the `uq_go_ride_requests_active_instant_vehicle` index predicate — scheduled rides and `requested` never set it. MYR-286 adds the P1 owner-entered `licensePlate`, shown here in BOTH of its states: Stumpy has one, Lightning's owner has not entered one and carries an EMPTY STRING rather than a missing key (the same always-emitted convention as `color`). Consumers keep the `VIN ····xxxx` fallback for the empty case and must never render an empty plate. MYR-316 adds the P0 nullable `serviceEstimatedEndAt` — the resolved end of the car's current service visit, COALESCE(Tesla `service_data.service_etc`, owner-entered expected-back), emitted ONLY while `status` is `in_service`. Neither row here is in service (`parked` / `charging`), so both carry the honest `null`; a null means NO scheduling bound at all, never 'unknown, block the picker'.
